IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Commerce & Labor (originally sponsored by Representatives Conway, Wood and Ormsby)

Bill.BriefDescription: Finding that HVAC/R mechanic certification laws may need to be modified and that a trade coordination panel may need to be established.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to certification of mechanics performing heating,ventilating, air conditioning, refrigeration, and gas piping work; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that state lawsrelating to certification of mechanics performing heating, ventilating,air conditioning, refrigeration, and gas piping work may need to bemodified to address industry concerns. In addition, the legislaturefinds that a trade coordination panel may need to be established torecommend preferred alternatives for resolving conflicts involving thescopes of work performed by the plumbing, electrical, and other tradesto their respective boards.
